svg.aria-label: Constructed transmission calibration: six concentrations with three independent noise realizations each. Pale-yellow side intervals define the baseline before fixed-window integration. The unknown is estimated at about 0.647 mol/L; residual and transmittance plots help interpret the calibration and acquisition conditions.
